page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, configured with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 40 MB of L3 cache. Memory capacity is 60.0 GB, yielding 7.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. Additional bundled resources include 472 GB of attached local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results illustrate strong GPU acceleration relative to central processor performance. Synthetic CPU evaluations reflect legacy host capabilities, registering poor single-core stress-ng scores (954.2) and weak multi-core output (4765.11), alongside an average PassMark CPU score of 6724.43. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average large-block write speeds at 26.02 GB/sec but lower read bandwidth. Conversely, inference tests demonstrate competitive GPU-bound throughput, achieving top-tier results for LLM prompt processing on 7B models (316.69 tokens/sec) and 7B text generation (42.77 tokens/sec).

The instance offers a specialized hardware balance by pairing dedicated Pascal-era GPU acceleration with local SSD storage and moderate memory capacity. Tradeoffs include legacy CPU architecture performance and modest baseline networking bandwidth compared to newer GPU server generations. Given its specification profile, this server is suitable for small-to-medium machine learning inference, model evaluation, static web serving, and general CUDA-accelerated tasks requiring local disk storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores. It features 60.0 GB of system memory, 472 GB of local SSD storage, 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Synthetic benchmarks highlight weak CPU-bound compute and memory bandwidth, offset by high GPU inference performance on small to medium language models. Specifically, the instance delivers top-tier prompt processing and generation rates for 7B models. Tradeoffs include older host architecture performance, making it less suitable for heavy CPU-bound parallel processing. Overall, this server is well suited for light to moderate machine learning inference, computer vision, and GPU-driven scientific computing tasks requiring low-latency disk storage.
